prompt:
UI design mockup of the project screen of an AI software factory: the one screen a person uses to steer a software project that AI agents build. Desktop browser viewport, 16:9, flat, no browser chrome, no device frame, the screen fills the whole image.

Three elements in order of weight: the pulse (one sentence, what to know now) on top; the chat with the project agent as the main affordance, the place a person acts; the kanban board for the granular task state, quiet, scanned not read. Normal states whisper, exceptional states speak: the two items in Needs you are the loudest things on the screen, a done card is quiet.

Content, spelled exactly. Top bar: "Factory console", the project "ai-software-factory-code", links "Board", "New task", "Projects", "Resources", "Costs", "Policy", "Alerts", a theme toggle, "sebastian", "Log out". Status figures: "waiting on you", "3 working", "2 need you", "€61.40 / €120.00", "GitHub: 1 open pull request". Pulse sentence: "Two cards need your decision; #612's merge carries a migration." with a warning sign and "more".
Board, five columns. "Needs you 2": a merge approval "Merge PR #612" with chips "high risk" and "migration", the line "Model review: approve. Adds the column safely.", the line "Recommendation: adds the column; merge it.", buttons "Approve as you", "Deny", "Split"; an escalation "#603 Which store for the session table?" with choice buttons "Postgres", "SQLite", "Ask the author" and a text box "Or your own answer". "Queued 4": "#455 Live check: close (Stage 16, 3.4)" chip "backlog"; "#178 Console: show the configuration version" chip "backlog"; "#620 Costs read: a from and a to date" chip "blocked by 2"; "#558.3 Export in pull request mode" chip "part of plan #558". "Working 3": "#601 Console: the drawer's Overview top block", "running · 23 min · 3/4 checks · €1.72 / €2.00 ⚠ near its budget", activity line "Reading internal/console/board.go…"; "#598 GitHub sync pulls a card", "running · 41 min", activity line "Running go test ./internal/console"; "#611 Acceptance: export as the human", "running · 8 min", activity line "Writing acceptance/export_test.go". "Verifying 2": "#612 Ledger: the month cap per project", "in review · 4/4 checks · PR #612"; "#609 Pulse: a provider budget alert", "merge queue". "Done 8", quiet one-line entries: "#490 README.md: extend the intro" done, "#616 Chat form: center the Send button" done, "#610 Fresh-context and aged-read acceptance tests" done, "#607 Live check 3.11: split pre-check" failed, "#608 Console polish: clamp board chip objectives" done, "#604 Members page" done, "#599 Alerts: verdict buttons" closed, "#597 Timeline: the gates meter" done.
Chat: "Chat", "project agent · ai-software-factory-code", a "New conversation" button. Messages: you: "Why is #603 waiting?"; agent: "#603 asked which store the session table should use. The plan named Postgres; the brief allows SQLite for a single replica. I can answer Postgres for you."; a collapsed tool block "read card #603 · 0.4 s"; a proposal card "I will: answer #603 with Postgres, then move #620 to ready" with buttons "Do it" and "Skip". The message box "Ask or tell the project… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line)" and a "Send" button.

Direction "Glass depth": macOS or Arc. Translucent panels with background blur over a soft dark gradient (dark) or a soft light gradient (light), 12 px radii, thin inner highlights, soft shadows. The chat as the front pane, the largest, centred, the main region; the board as a dimmed pane behind and to the left; the pulse as a floating capsule on top. One blue accent, SF-like sans, 14 px. Light theme: a light background with dark text, the same design as the dark version in the day mood.

Legible UI text with exact spelling, nothing invented. Made by a top product design studio. Not a template, not a slide deck, not a generic admin dashboard.
label: 14-glass-depth-light · nano-banana
